title: 熔点测定
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/172_熔点测定.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/172_熔点测定/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在熔点仪旁，手拿一根细毛细管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a compact electric melting point apparatus with an eyepiece, holding up a thin glass capillary tube, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十课：熔点测定。

shots.scene: 阿杰把湿漉漉的大颗晶体塞满半根毛细管
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stuffs damp, coarse crystals into a capillary tube until it is half full, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰把湿的大颗晶体塞了半管。

shots.scene: 他把旋钮拧到最大，伸手去摸加热块
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power dial turned all the way to maximum and a bare hand reaching to touch a hot metal heating block, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮拧到最大，还伸手摸加热块。

shots.scene: 只记了一个温度，小研摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a notebook with only one number written and shakes her head at the young male student beside the apparatus.
shots.narration: 小研：这样测，数据不可信。

shots.scene: 两个问题：纯不纯？是不是它？
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a vial of crystals with two question icons above it, one a purity gauge and one an identity badge. No text.
shots.narration: 晶体纯不纯？是不是要的化合物？

shots.scene: 测熔点两个问题都能回答
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a capillary in a melting point apparatus with arrows to a purity gauge and an identity badge, both checked. No text.
shots.narration: 测一测熔点，两个问题都能回答。

shots.scene: 和粗品、文献值比一比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three temperature bars side by side, crude product, purified product and a reference book value, the purified bar matching the book. No text.
shots.narration: 重结晶后，和粗品、文献值比一比。

shots.scene: 分子间引力把分子拉在晶格里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: molecules arranged in a neat crystal lattice held by small spring-like attraction lines. No text.
shots.narration: 晶体里，分子间引力把分子拉住。

shots.scene: 加热后分子振动越来越剧烈
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same lattice with heat waves below, molecules vibrating more strongly, motion lines growing. No text.
shots.narration: 加热后分子动能变大，越振越猛。

shots.scene: 动能胜过引力，晶格瓦解成液体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lattice breaking apart into a disordered liquid, a balance tipping from attraction to motion. No text.
shots.narration: 动能胜过引力，晶格瓦解成液体。

shots.scene: 在一段温度内熔化：熔程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a temperature scale with a short highlighted band from first liquid to fully melted, an example band near one hundred fourteen degrees. No text.
shots.narration: 固体在一段温度内熔化，叫熔程。

shots.scene: 熔点仪部件：开关、样品座、照明、目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generic electric melting point apparatus with a power switch, a sample block with capillary slots, a light and a magnifying eyepiece highlighted, no logos. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点仪：开关、样品座、灯和目镜。

shots.scene: 温度显示和升温旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a digital temperature display and a heating rate dial on the apparatus, both highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 还有温度显示和加热旋钮。

shots.scene: 旋钮只管升温快慢
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dial at low with a gentle slope line and at high with a steep slope line, a speed icon, not a stop point. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮越大升温越快，只管快慢。

shots.scene: 加热块随时当它是热的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sample block with a hot surface warning sign and heat waves, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点仪随时当它是热的，别碰。

shots.scene: 冷下来再用镊子取管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooling clock icon, then tweezers lifting a used capillary out of the block. No text.
shots.narration: 冷一冷，用镊子取出熔点管。

shots.scene: 用过的熔点管进碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used capillary tubes dropped into a labeled broken glass box, a general trash bin crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的熔点管，放进碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 用完关闭熔点仪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger turning the dial to zero and switching the apparatus off. No text.
shots.narration: 用完旋钮归零，关掉电源。

shots.scene: 备好刮勺、表面皿、研钵、毛细管和长玻璃管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spatula, a watch glass, a small mortar and pestle, a bundle of capillary tubes and a long glass tube laid out on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 备好刮勺、表面皿、研钵和毛细管。

shots.scene: 湿样用滤纸吸干，不进烘箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: damp crystals pressed between filter paper, an oven crossed out because the sample may melt or decompose. No text.
shots.narration: 样品要干，湿的用滤纸吸干。

shots.scene: 【实拍】大颗晶体在研钵里研细
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a pestle gently grinding a few large sugar crystals into a fine powder in a small mortar, safety goggles visible.
shots.narration: 大颗晶体研细，戴好护目镜。

shots.scene: 颗粒大有空隙，受热不均
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: coarse crystals with air gaps heating unevenly beside fine packed powder heating evenly, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 颗粒大有空隙，受热就不均匀。

shots.scene: 【实拍】毛细管开口朝下轻戳粉末
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the open end of a thin capillary tube pressed down several times into a small pile of fine white powder on a watch glass.
shots.narration: 开口朝下，轻戳几下带进样品。

shots.scene: 【实拍】正过来轻敲，样品落到管底
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the capillary turned closed end down and tapped gently on the bench so the powder slides to the bottom.
shots.narration: 正过来轻轻敲，让样品落到底。

shots.scene: 【实拍】从长玻璃管里落下压实
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the capillary dropped closed end down through a long vertical glass tube onto the bench, bouncing to pack the powder, repeated.
shots.narration: 落不下就从长管里丢下，压实。

shots.scene: 【实拍】比一比装样高度
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a packed capillary held next to a small ruler, a short dense column of powder at the bottom.
shots.narration: 装样约两三毫米，压紧不留空。

shots.scene: 装多了熔程变宽，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overfilled capillary with a tall loose column crossed out, a short packed column checked. No text.
shots.narration: 装多装松，受热不均就不准。

shots.scene: 一份样品装四支
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four packed capillary tubes in a row, one marked with a quick icon and three marked as repeats. No text.
shots.narration: 一份样品装四支：一粗测三平行。

shots.scene: 不知道大概熔点，先粗测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a question mark over a temperature scale, a fast forward arrow, a clock showing time saved. No text.
shots.narration: 不知道大概熔点？先测个粗熔点。

shots.scene: 旋钮归零，等仪器冷到室温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dial at zero and the temperature display dropping to room temperature. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮归零，等仪器冷到室温。

shots.scene: 快速升温记个大概
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a steep heating line at ten to twenty degrees per minute and a rough melting mark noted. No text.
shots.narration: 每分钟升十到二十度，记个大概。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冷态插入毛细管
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a packed capillary tube inserted gently, closed end down, into a slot of the sample block of a switched off apparatus.
shots.narration: 装好的管子轻轻插进样品座。

shots.scene: 离预期熔点还远，可快升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a temperature line rising quickly, far below an expected melting point mark. No text.
shots.narration: 离预期熔点还远，可以快升。

shots.scene: 近熔点放慢到每分钟一到二度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the line flattening about fifteen to twenty degrees below the expected mark, a slow snail icon. No text.
shots.narration: 近熔点十几二十度，放慢到一两度。

shots.scene: 升温太快：管跟不上加热块
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the block temperature racing ahead of the sample inside the capillary, a lag gap, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 最常见错误：升温太快。

shots.scene: 测得熔点偏高、熔程偏窄
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a measured band shifted higher and narrower than the true band, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 测出来熔点偏高，熔程偏窄。

shots.scene: 从目镜里盯着样品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles looks into the eyepiece of the apparatus from a normal seated distance.
shots.narration: 从目镜里盯着样品，别凑近加热块。

shots.scene: 下沉、变软、收缩还不算熔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the powder column sagging, softening and shrinking, a not yet icon. No text.
shots.narration: 样品下沉、变软、收缩，还不算熔。

shots.scene: 出现第一滴液体：初熔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the first tiny drop of clear liquid appearing in the powder, a temperature reading noted. No text.
shots.narration: 出现第一滴液体，记下初熔。

shots.scene: 最后一粒晶体消失：全熔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the last crystal vanishing in clear liquid, a second temperature reading noted, the two forming a range. No text.
shots.narration: 最后一粒晶体消失，记下全熔。

shots.scene: 取出丢弃，等降到熔点以下二十度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the dial turned down, the used tube removed with tweezers into a broken glass box, the display cooling to well below the melting point. No text.
shots.narration: 取出旧管，等降到熔点下二十度。

shots.scene: 再测两支，看能否重现
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two more capillaries measured one after another, three similar ranges lined up with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 再测两支，看结果能不能重现。

shots.scene: 熔过的样品不再熔一次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a used melted capillary put back into the block crossed out, icons of oxidation and decomposition. No text.
shots.narration: 熔过的样品可能变质，不再重熔。

shots.scene: 杂质扰乱晶格，削弱引力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crystal lattice with a few odd impurity molecules disrupting the order, weaker attraction lines. No text.
shots.narration: 杂质扰乱晶格，分子间引力变弱。

shots.scene: 熔点变低，熔程变宽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pure sample with a narrow band and an impure sample with a lower, wider band. No text.
shots.narration: 不纯：熔点变低，熔程变宽。

shots.scene: 熔程超过两三度，多半不纯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a band spanning several degrees with a warning icon, a sharp narrow band with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 熔程超过两三度，多半不纯。

shots.scene: 和手册里的熔点比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a measured range compared with a value in a reference handbook, the handbook showing only the upper value. No text.
shots.narration: 鉴定未知物，和手册熔点比一比。

shots.scene: 再结合光谱才可能确定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a melting point icon plus a spectrum chart leading to an identity check. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点相同不够，还要结合光谱。

shots.scene: 未知物和推测物按比例混合
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unknown powder and a known reference powder mixed in three different ratios in three small piles. No text.
shots.narration: 未知物和推测物，混合测熔点。

shots.scene: 都一样可能是它，降低变宽就不是
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three identical sharp ranges with a possible check, versus a lowered broad range with a definite cross. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点不变可能是它，降低就不是。

shots.scene: 加热时样品不见了：在升华
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the powder in an open capillary disappearing as vapor rises out of the open end. No text.
shots.narration: 样品不见了？那是在升华。

shots.scene: 开口端熔封后再测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the open end of the capillary sealed closed under teacher guidance, solvent bottles kept far away, then measured again. No text.
shots.narration: 可把开口端熔封后再测。

shots.scene: 封口管会憋压，戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed capillary with pressure arrows inside, a face too close to the block crossed out, safety goggles checked. No text.
shots.narration: 封口管受热憋压，戴护目镜只看目镜。

shots.scene: 变色冒烟是分解，通风处测，注明分解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the sample darkening and giving off a faint wisp, the apparatus in a well ventilated spot, a notebook with a decomposition mark. No text.
shots.narration: 变色冒烟是分解，通风处测要注明。

shots.scene: 测得总不对：用标准物质校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several vials of reference substances with well known and widely spaced melting points. No text.
shots.narration: 熔点总不准？用标准物质校准。

shots.scene: 逐个测定，作校准曲线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chart plotting actual values against observed values with a straight fitted line through several points. No text.
shots.narration: 逐个测定，画出校准曲线。

shots.scene: 按曲线换算真实熔点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from an observed sample value up to the line and across to the corrected value. No text.
shots.narration: 用曲线换算样品的真实熔点。

shots.scene: 老式b形管油浴：热油会烫伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old style b-shaped glass tube filled with heating oil clamped on a stand, a hot oil burn icon. No text.
shots.narration: 老式b形管油浴，热油容易烫伤。

shots.scene: 油温过高冒烟着火，进水飞溅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: overheated oil smoking with a small flame icon and a water drop falling into hot oil spattering, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 油过热会冒烟着火，进水会飞溅。

shots.scene: 夹牢、小心加热、冷后再拆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the tube clamped firmly, gentle heating, a cooling clock before taking apart, a dry clean tube. No text.
shots.narration: 夹牢、慢加热、冷了再拆。

shots.scene: 优先用电加热熔点仪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electric melting point apparatus checked beside the oil bath setup with a downward arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 有条件，优先用电加热熔点仪。

shots.scene: 老式汞温度计：轻拿轻放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an old glass liquid temperature gauge with a silver liquid column handled gently with two hands. No text.
shots.narration: 老式汞温度计，轻拿轻放防碰断。

shots.scene: 破了不扫不吸，隔离并报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny silver beads on a bench beside broken glass, a broom and a vacuum cleaner crossed out, the area roped off, a phone call icon. No text.
shots.narration: 破了别扫别吸，隔离报告老师。

shots.scene: 用汞处理工具包收集，按危废处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spill kit with a sealable container and absorbent powder, then a labeled hazardous waste container. No text.
shots.narration: 按溢洒程序收集，作危废处理。

shots.scene: 样品干、研细、少而紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dry fine powder, a short packed capillary and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 样品干燥研细，装得少而紧。

shots.scene: 先快后慢，记初熔和全熔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heating curve flattening near the mark, and two readings forming a range. No text.
shots.narration: 先快后慢，记下初熔和全熔。

shots.scene: 熔程窄而接近文献值才纯；当心烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrow band matching a book value, a hot surface warning sign and a broken glass box. No text.
shots.narration: 熔程窄、近文献值才纯，当心烫。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块薄层色谱板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small white chromatography plate with a few colored spots, standing beside a covered glass chamber, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：薄层色谱。
